description: UNIQUE (and exactly_once) of every order of small text sets holding an intransitive cycle of Excel's comparison: {A3,A4,A6,A7}, {A4..A8}, {A3,A4,A5} of the t3211 Data sheet, and two-column rows where one column holds the cycle; A lists the kept rows, B the exactly_once rows, C the input order (T-4200)
